name: dev.arpan.location.engine.LocationSettingsActivity
description: Location Engine, Arpan Sarkar's location library for Google and Huawei services, opens this Activity when a location request needs permission or a change to the device's location setting. It requests location permission and can show the system prompt to enable location.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents this library's permission and location setup from completing, so app features that rely on its location requests may fail.
